Dragonscaled.description: Hatched near glowing dragon hordes or elemental cauldrons.

features.name: Dragonscaled Kobold
features.tldr: Your scales harden, granting elemental resistance matching a specific dragon type.

Tunneler.description: Bred to slip through tight subterranean crevices and narrow shafts.

features.name: Tunneler Kobold
features.tldr: You squeeze through narrow spaces with ease and avoid movement penalties underground.
